_note.text: Copy this file to thresholds.json (repo root, or point CAIS_THRESHOLDS_PATH at it) and adjust the values you want to change. Only the listed check names and only the listed parameter keys are accepted; unknown names or keys raise a ValueError at startup. Any key you omit uses the built-in default shown here. Note: positivity.extreme_ps_bounds is also the overlap band used by the trimmed-IPW leaf when the positivity gate fails.
